endpointName: Quartz Creek bridge / Forest Road 247 mile 32
rationale: Current reviewed sources establish only a bridge/road vicinity and a fair access point near the Quartz Creek confluence. They do not establish a lawful public take-out, parking/carry route, or water-entry coordinate; one river guide explicitly warns that Quartz Creek is not a good take-out for inflatables. Withhold the route pending manager-backed access evidence.
condition: Require Forest Service confirmation of a public landing, legal parking/carry approach, and exact water-entry coordinate before release.
